pages.text: A current makes a magnetic field. Around a long straight wire it circles the wire, and its strength falls with distance: B = μ₀I/(2πr). Ten amps give 40 µT five centimetres away - about the strength of the planet's own field.

The $(item)Gauss Meter$() reads the field where you stand: the planet's (25 to 65 µT in the Overworld, none in the Nether or the End) and any magnets near you (block tag $(thing)magnetic$(): lodestones, and more to come).
